Project 002 · 2024–2025

JBB Global Services

Brand Strategy, Logo Refresh & Stationery · Bakery & Table Water, Delta, Nigeria
Timeline
2024–2025
Engagement
Freelance client engagement
Deliverables
7 deliverable types

JBB Global Services is principally involved in bakery and table water and operates in Delta, Nigeria. This was a freelance client engagement.

The Problem

The old identity was difficult to use, informal, and visually dated. It did not support a business aiming to reach a wider national market.

The Strategic Move

Retain the globe from the previous identity because it represented the company's ambition to penetrate the national market, and rebuild it as a cleaner, more reproducible, more professional globe-and-orbit system. Drag the slider to see the difference for yourself.

What We Built
  • Brand strategy
  • Logo refresh
  • Letterhead
  • Business card
  • Stationery
  • Print-ready assets
  • Letterhead produced in collaboration with third-party print services

Alongside the refresh, the work extended to clearer communication with trade buyers and customers.

Outcome

A clearer, more professional, more usable identity for formal stationery and customer-facing materials.

↔
drag to compare

The Mark

Old mark: a hand-drawn globe outline with an orbit ring, uneven line weights, colours that didn't hold up at small sizes. New mark: a cleaner orbiting-globe icon built to scale down to an app icon or social avatar without losing its shape, plus a wordmark lockup and a text-free ring variant for tight placements.

Applied

The refreshed system carried onto other collateral already in circulation, including product flyers for both lines, bread and table water.

“A dedicated, proactive leader who improved our brand and productivity through excellent communication.”

Jolomi Brown BoyoOwner & CEO, JBB Global Services
